flavor: A massive, translucent pillar of blue ice stands in the center of the chamber, preserving a colossal, multi-winged creature mid-flight. Tiny, frozen bubbles are suspended within the frost, catching the dim light like trapped stars.
name: The Glacial Ossuary
reason: The room serves as a centerpiece for players to interact with a preserved prehistoric specimen, offering a moment of awe and potential lore discovery before the next encounter.
